GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (cross-over nose band first time) jumped ok , gradually Crossed up from Wide out. Slight Lead Two Wide @ 800m then Kept Coming and found the rail 1 length Clear 600m. Kept Finding more than enough in Straight # crossed/led/kicked
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the gelding leading, rider reported that he had been issued the same instructions as were reported by Stewards at Coffs Harbour on 1 March 2026, which were to allow the gelding to settle where comfortable from the wide barrier. He added that on this occasion the gelding began well and, when it became apparent his mount would be caught wide and without cover, he allowed it to stride forward to obtain the lead. Owner confirmed the nature of the instructions.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 3 Lengths , overraced back last off poor start 11 Lengths 800m, worked widest from the corner but only battled under riding and never came on # never came on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT – from wide barrier will be permitted to settle where comfortable, bounded on jumping & settled at rear of field. Rdr stated mount settled at rear of field & overraced fiercely between 1100m & 600m, behind a moderate tempo. Rdr stated that passing 600m he elected to shift his mount wide on track and commence working forward rather than continue to fight it. Rdr stated mount failed to sprint strongly down straight & the manner in which it raced in e&m stages was to the detriment of its finishing effort. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear, headed approaching 100m, got tired final 50m, just no match winner once headed. # 1 better/gap to 3rd
